execution.artifacts: private per-record predictions and receipt; public aggregate metrics, lineage and intervals
execution.evaluation_runner: implement and test runner separately; freeze execution code revision/hash/environment before any test inference
execution.failed_predictions: abort publication; record failure; repair execution only; never drop examples
execution.retry: resume only identical locked artifacts/settings; reuse saved completed predictions; record every attempt

limitations: held-out SEntFiN evaluation; no known accessible-corpus overlap; pretraining exposure unknown
SEntFiN is Indian-market financial headlines, not a validated five-company US benchmark
Development scores reused for epoch/rate selection and calibration research
Hosted FinBERT weight-license scope unresolved; previously authorized private noncommercial research; no weight or headline redistribution

paired_comparisons.interpretation: paired percentile intervals; no multiplicity-adjusted significance claims; seeds are not independent test datasets

brier.definition: mean sum over classes of squared error against one-hot gold

reference_candidate.basis: highest observed selected-rate development mean macro F1; not chosen on final-test results

scope_decisions.deberta_large: deferred; any experiment informed by final scores is exploratory and requires new untouched data for confirmatory claims
scope_decisions.length_batch_search: deferred; fixed length128 train16/eval32; no additional search before final evaluation
scope_decisions.mlflow: deferred; retain checksummed JSON/configs/artifacts plus execution receipt; no MLflow completion claim
scope_decisions.multi_target_test: reserved for Phase4; no broadcast or target-aware scoring in Phase3
scope_decisions.other_transformers: financial adapted/unchanged and PhraseBank-only variants remain development diagnostics; excluded from this bounded final comparison
scope_decisions.phrasebank_tests: reserved and unscored; not part of this independent evaluation
scope_decisions.post_test: do not tune, recalibrate, relabel, choose best seed or replace locked comparison after seeing results

seed_policy.aggregation: mean and sample SD of separately evaluated metrics

timing.calibration_overhead: time separately on CPU; no retraining
timing.gpu_timing: synchronize before/after batched inference; exclude loading and metric calculation
